subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: For empty plugin scopes and plugin cache reloads, which agent harness entries should remain selectable in the process-global registry while the active plugin registry is empty or being rebuilt?
rationale: Current source still exposes clear-and-empty registry windows, but the candidate fix changes plugin disablement and activation semantics by restoring every prior harness; automation cannot choose that ownership contract safely.

options.title: Preserve Approved Always-On Harnesses
options.body: Preserve only maintainer-approved built-in or provider-owned harnesses during empty-scope reloads, and explicitly clear disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

options.title: Accept Restore-All Semantics
options.body: Allow all previously registered harnesses to survive empty-scope reloads and document that plugin disablement does not immediately remove process-global harnesses.

options.title: Use Readiness or Retry Instead
options.body: Keep empty-scope clearing strict and queue or retry channel dispatch until plugin runtime readiness is restored.

recommendation.title: Preserve Approved Always-On Harnesses
recommendation.body: Preserve only maintainer-approved built-in or provider-owned harnesses during empty-scope reloads, and explicitly clear disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the pluggable agent harness registry and is the strongest history signal for deciding the registry ownership contract.
